description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with effect from 25.12.2023 to 31.12.2023
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It represents a regulatory matter involving statutory instruments and compliance requirements for customs operations, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) rather than government personnel/structure categories.
